task.title: Review the community PR, the crash issue and the 1.5 eating reports
task.description:
Deferred while VM2 has priority (hub decision variety-matters-priority, 2026-10-17). 1) Review community PR 2 (https://github.com/Evyatar108/Rimworld-VarietyMatters/pull/2) against a reproduction of issue 1 (https://github.com/Evyatar108/Rimworld-VarietyMatters/issues/1): an ownerless ThingDef causes initialization and food-job exceptions on RimWorld 1.6. The contributor supplies a regression harness and reports a successful build; neither has been run. 2) Separately reproduce the 2026-05-17 Workshop reports that pawns stop eating on 1.5, and the 2026-05-03 report of Gourmet Meals with different condiments merging under Vanilla Cooking Expanded. A passing 1.6 test does not close the 1.5 reports. 3) Check whether each fix also applies to VM2, which forked from this code. Dated comments: the hub's evidence\2026-10-17\steam-recent-comments-dated.json.

Created 2026-10-17 from the mod-portfolio hub (the hub's MODS.md). Read this repository's CLAUDE.md and the hub's SHARED-PRACTICES.md first, and record results with the hub's templates\MOD-VERIFICATION.md. This task grants no deploy, push, Workshop upload or public reply.
task.notes:
2026-10-17 feedback sweep (all 45 Bug Reports replies, capture the hub's evidence\2026-10-17\steam-3044059819-2139.json). New reports beyond this task's description, each also filed against VM2: (1) 'Null key while loading dictionary ... label=VarietyRecordV2' on load, 3 reports from 2 players, latest 2026-06-16, after the April update; lead: VarietyRecord.cs:143 saves pawn-keyed trackers by reference (VM2 task vm2-diettracker-null-pawn-key). (2) Pawns repeat one meal and cooks ignore farther ingredients, 4 reports 2024-06 to 2026-08 (vm2-variety-seeking-reports). (3) VCE - Haute forced ingredient variety broken, 2026-02-10, alongside the known Gourmet condiment stacking (vm2-vce-compat-reports). Older items with no follow-up since 2024: malnutrition Feed option missing (Tyfo 2024-01, logs requested, none sent), NullReferenceException on every save (Tagaris 2024-02), 'DietTracker:: Variety reason mismatch' (chainlinc3 2024-05), settings described on the Workshop page missing from the menu (lintence91 2024-06). Status of these is unknown.

2026-10-17 GitHub check (feedback_sweep --github-only): PR 2 now reports CONFLICTING against master, because master gained the 111 April commits pushed today. Commit 1a6e900 (2026-04-18, F-007) already made GetRaceKey null-safe in the same way, (thingDef.modContentPack?.Name ?? "null") + "-" + defName, and VM2 has the same line. Issue 1 was observed on 2026-08-24, four months after that commit, so the Workshop build that player had probably predates the April work. Before reviewing PR 2: confirm which commit the Workshop release was built from (MODS.md release-tracking gap). If the guard is already in what subscribers run, close issue 1 and PR 2 with thanks; the PR's regression harness may still be worth keeping. Any GitHub comment or close is Evyatar's to approve.

2026-10-17 later: confirmed. The Workshop subscription copy on this PC (3044059819\1.6\Assemblies\VarietyMatters.dll in `steam_workshop` (see `python tools\hub_paths.py`), 89,600 bytes, file date 2026-04-21) decompiles to the unguarded GetRaceKey: thingDef.modContentPack.Name + "-" + thingDef.defName. So subscribers run a build without 1a6e900, and issue 1 applies to them. The Workshop page's 2026-04-18 update and the guard commit (23:00 PDT that day) are the same date, but the uploaded build doesn't contain it. The deployed Steam Mods copy (121,856 bytes, 2026-04-19) and a source build (146,944 bytes) are both newer. Which commit the Workshop build came from is still unknown. Reply draft D5 in the hub's FEEDBACK.md.

2026-10-17 (hub tools\release_freeze.py audit): the Workshop subscription copy (folder 3044059819 in `steam_workshop`, see `python tools\hub_paths.py`) has no LoadFolders.xml. Without one, RimWorld loads only the version folder, Common and the root (decompiled Verse.ModContentPack.InitLoadFolders), so the shipped Mods\Vanilla Plants + Fishing\Patches\VanillaPlants_Variety.xml and Mods\SYR Coffee + Blueberries\Patches\ModPatch_SYR_Coffee.xml never load for subscribers, whatever mods they run. Source has had LoadFolders.xml since 2023; the deploy used for the upload evidently didn't copy root files (rimworld-tools deploy_steam.sh copies it now). Possibly related: mayana's 2026-08-13 variety report lists Vanilla Plants Expanded. Any Redux re-upload must include LoadFolders.xml; run release_freeze.py audit on the deployed folder first. The deployed Steam copy also carries a design\ folder and a 5.4 MB Preview.png, both blocking for an upload.

2026-10-18 readiness audit (hub rule task-readiness-tags): tagged needs-evyatar: Redux is deferred while VM2 has priority (hub decision variety-matters-priority); a Redux hotfix for the live GetRaceKey crash and missing LoadFolders.xml is an open decision in the hub's MODS.md.

2026-10-20: moved to Blocked under the hub's rule task-readiness-tags (decision portfolio-board): Tasks Board's native 'next' view ignores tags and offered needs-evyatar tasks as ready work. The stage reason says what Evyatar decides or does; move the task back to Backlog when he has.

2026-10-21 finding: 2026-10-21, lane VM2-TEST of the hub parallel run: the 'Null key while loading dictionary ... VarietyRecordV2' report has a cause and a fix in VM2 (F-035, commit fded428 on VM2's feat/test-project, unmerged). VarietyRecord.DietRecord is static and never emptied, so a second colony in the same session saves the previous colony's pawns, and a new pawn with the same ID inherits the old pawn's diet. This repository's Source\VarietyRecord.cs is byte-identical to VM2's before the fix, so Redux has the same bug, which fits the 1.4 to 1.6 player logs. Porting is three small changes in one file plus one condition (hub evidence\2026-10-21\parallel-run\lane-VM2-TEST-report.md). Waits for the hub's decide-redux-hotfix; the lane recommends porting after VM2's in-game checks pass.

2026-10-21 finding: 2026-10-21, lane VM2-READY (hub parallel run): the Workshop DLL lacks VM2's Pawn.Kill and Pawn.Destroy hooks (commit 1b51771); with the between-games leak VM2 fixed as F-035, that explains the null-key save reports. This repository's master LoadFolders.xml leaves out Common, where the keyed English text lives (VM2 task vm2-loadfolders-common); a release cut from master would show raw VM_ keys. Waits for the hub's decide-redux-hotfix.

2026-10-21 finding: Two more bugs in this repository's source, found by VM2's food-search performance audit (VM2 branch design/full-potential-pass, design\research\perf-food-search-2026-10-21.md, 'Bugs found' 1 and 2; VM2 tasks vm2-settings-recount-thread and vm2-foodsource-cache-clear): (1) Source\New\Performance\DebouncedSettingsHandler.cs:32,51: the settings timer calls LongEventHandler.ExecuteWhenFinished from a thread-pool thread, and in 1.6 that runs the recount at once on that thread during normal play, so pawns' meal queues change off the main thread; (2) Source\New\FoodSourceFactory.cs:9: one meal record per food item, shared when a pawn eats part of a stack twice and never freed. Whether the Workshop build contains the same code is unchecked. Worth fixing in any Redux hotfix; the VM2 fixes can be ported.
